about: Story Night: lines and events every arc shares. recall = general callback lines ({who} {deed} = a memory that really happened earlier in this story). fallback = lines used when an outcome has nothing that fits (say a co-op minigame on a competitive encounter). interludes = quick choices with no minigame. titles = the epilogue's fun titles (stat: stars | led | wins | lasts | deeds | mood:<bold|kind|clever|silly> | fallback).
recall: After {who} {deed}, nothing seems quite so scary.
{who} {deed} earlier tonight. That gives everyone courage.
Not long ago, {who} {deed}. The fair is still talking about it.
Since {who} {deed}, the party walks a little taller.

lose: Not quite, but nobody gives up.

interludes.title: Candy Floss Cart
text: A candy floss cart is still spinning, all on its own.
There is just enough for one huge cloud.

choices.label: Share it with everyone
choices.text: {hero} tears the cloud into fluffy pieces. Sticky smiles all round!

choices.label: Eat it all, fast
choices.text: {hero} eats the whole cloud in four bites. Pink face, big grin.

deed.text: ate a whole cloud of candy floss

interludes.title: The Fortune Cat
text: A stripy cat sits on a fortune-teller's table.
It blinks slowly. It wants something.

choices.label: Scratch its chin
choices.text: The cat purrs and knocks a lucky token off the table.

deed.text: made friends with the fortune cat

choices.label: Ask it a question
choices.text: The cat thinks very hard, then falls asleep. Probably a yes.

interludes.title: A Lost Hat
text: A tall striped hat lies in a puddle.

choices.label: Wear it proudly
choices.text: {hero} puts on the soggy hat. It drips, but it looks grand.

choices.label: Hang it on a lamp post
choices.text: {hero} hangs the hat up high where its owner will see it.

interludes.title: The High Striker
text: The High Striker bell is glowing.
A sign says: RING ME FOR LUCK.

choices.label: Swing the mallet!
choices.text: DONG! The bell rings so loud a pigeon faints. It is fine.

choices.label: Tiptoe past it
choices.text: Better not wake the whole fair. Everyone sneaks by.

titles.title: Bravest Tumbler
titles.text: Came last the most, and kept smiling
